subject: Request: Standby credit + term-waiver approval for NimblePay latency outage

From: David Chen <david.chen@nimblepay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:07:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Production latency spikes affecting Checkout API

Hi Monica —

We started seeing sustained 95th percentile latency spikes on our Checkout API at ~08:30 PST this morning that caused a small but visible increase in failures for customers in California. Our SREs collected the attached logs and an incident timeline. This is the second service-impacting latency spike in ~8 weeks; it's eroding confidence with our product team.

Can Redwood propose a remediation package including concrete credits and a short-term SLA amendment while you investigate root cause? We need something we can show our CFO and Ops to stabilize the account while you resolve the underlying regression.

Meeting availability: 11/11 10–11am or 11/12 9–11am PT.

Thanks,
David
David Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, NimblePay

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:02:48 -08:00
Subject: RE: Production latency spikes affecting Checkout API — initial findings

Summary from ops: we saw a regressed kernel-path triggered by a particular sequence length distribution in NimblePay's traffic after the 2026-10 runtime build. The immediate mitigation was to route affected traffic to the fallback inference pool (latency returned to baseline within ~12 minutes).

Next steps:
- Full root-cause analysis (RCA) and patch ETA: 72 hours.
- Short-term remediation: keep NimblePay traffic on the fallback pool for the next 7 days, with increased monitoring and a kill-switch if we detect regression recurrence.

Commercial ask (for leadership):
- One month of service credit applied to the Nov invoice (pro-rated based on usage) to address near-term impact.
- If recurrence or broader SLA degradation occurs before RCA/patched rollout, consider a 2-month credit + early-termination fee waiver as a contingency.

I've attached a proposed credit worksheet and estimated P&L impact. Please advise on approval channel for the contingency ask — I'll need exec sign-off if we exceed the one-month goodwill.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_credit_calc.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: ACTION: Exec approval needed for NimblePay concession contingency

Team —

NimblePay (HP-3421) experienced a brief but material latency regression on 11/11 that was mitigated by routing to a fallback pool. Karthik's team has a patch ETA of 72 hours and recommended a conservative commercial remediation. Customer is asking for a tangible package they can present to their finance team.

Proposed package:
- Immediate: one pro-rated month credit applied to Nov invoice (this aligns with our goodwill precedent).
- Contingency: if a second qualifying SLA breach occurs within 60 days, escalate to: 2 months credit (pro-rated) + waiver of early-termination fees through the remainder of the current term.

Estimated impact: $68k gross revenue reduction (up to $120k if contingency triggers).

Approvals requested:
1) Marissa — approve immediate one-month credit today so we can respond to NimblePay's CFO.
2) Jonas — finance acknowledgement of P&L impact and confirmation that the contingency (2-month + ET waiver) requires your explicit exec sign-off before it's applied.
3) Markus — ops/partner risk acknowledgement for the ET-waiver precedent.

Attachments included in thread: incident timeline, error sample, credit calc.

I recommend we make the immediate concession available while we complete RCA and keep the contingency as an exec-level one-time exception, not a product change.

Thanks,
Monica
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: ACTION: Exec approval needed for NimblePay concession contingency — APPROVED (limited)

Monica / team — thank you for the clear summary and the impact estimate. I approve the following, effective immediately:

- Apply a one-month pro-rated invoice credit for November (estimate per attached calc).
- Offer NimblePay a one-time credit buffer equal to 25% of the contingency exposure to be used only if a qualifying SLA breach reoccurs within 60 days; this reduces our immediate cash impact while showing a meaningful commercial gesture.
- Do NOT auto-apply a full 2-month credit or ET-waiver unless Jonas signs off after the second qualifying breach and legal signs an amendment.

Jonas — please confirm you accept the staged approach from a finance controls perspective. Once Jonas confirms, Monica please respond to NimblePay with the concession language and a short timeline for RCA + patch. Ask NimblePay to confirm acceptance in writing (email ok).

—Marissa
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
